name: sku-inventory-manager-backend
description: Backend API for SKU Inventory Manager

scripts.test:frontend-compliance-e2e:matrix: cross-env RUN_BROWSER_E2E=true BROWSER_E2E_VIEWPORTS=desktop,mobile node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config jest.config.cjs --runInBand tests/frontend.complianceActivationReadiness.e2e.test.js
scripts.test:frontend-ims-pos-sales-e2e: cross-env RUN_BROWSER_E2E=true RUN_A11Y_MATRIX=false BROWSER_E2E_VIEWPORTS=desktop node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config jest.config.cjs --runInBand tests/frontend.imsPosSalesJourney.e2e.test.js
scripts.test:frontend-ims-pos-sales-e2e:release: cross-env RUN_BROWSER_E2E=true RUN_A11Y_MATRIX=false BROWSER_E2E_PROFILE=release BROWSER_E2E_VIEWPORTS=desktop node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config jest.config.cjs --runInBand tests/frontend.imsPosSalesJourney.e2e.test.js
scripts.test:frontend-ims-pos-sales-e2e:matrix: cross-env RUN_BROWSER_E2E=true RUN_A11Y_MATRIX=true BROWSER_E2E_VIEWPORTS=desktop,mobile node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config jest.config.cjs --runInBand tests/frontend.imsPosSalesJourney.e2e.test.js
scripts.test:hosting:shared: cross-env HOSTING_PROFILE=shared REDIS_URL= AUTH_BLACKLIST_FAILURE_MODE=fail_open TEMP_FILE_STORAGE=local STOREFRONT_DISCOVERY_REDIS_CACHE_ENABLED=false node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config jest.config.cjs --runInBand --runTestsByPath tests/hostingProfilePreflight.test.js tests/tempFileService.local.test.js tests/healthService.test.js tests/rateLimiterStoreMode.test.js
scripts.test:hosting:vps: cross-env HOSTING_PROFILE=vps REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6379 AUTH_BLACKLIST_FAILURE_MODE=fail_closed TEMP_FILE_STORAGE=auto STOREFRONT_DISCOVERY_REDIS_CACHE_ENABLED=true node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config jest.config.cjs --runInBand --runTestsByPath tests/hostingProfilePreflight.test.js tests/healthService.test.js tests/rateLimiterStoreMode.test.js
scripts.ai:check: npm run validate:ai && npm run generate:ai-docs
scripts.audit:indexes:local: node scripts/cleanup-test-tenants.js && cross-env SCHEMA_INDEX_AUDIT_MODE=local SCHEMA_INDEX_AUDIT_EXCLUDE_TEST_TENANTS=true node scripts/audit-indexes.js
scripts.audit:indexes:local:apply-cleanup: node scripts/cleanup-test-tenants.js --apply --yes && cross-env SCHEMA_INDEX_AUDIT_MODE=local SCHEMA_INDEX_AUDIT_EXCLUDE_TEST_TENANTS=true node scripts/audit-indexes.js
